MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "To All The Girls... and Partners appeal to my interest in romantic singing and vocal collaborations, which connects with my listening to Amor & Pasion and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "Ballads fits the slower, melodic mood I want now, while Home for Christmas connects with my earlier Christmas listening even though I would save it for the holidays."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "In The Lonely Hour and 25 do not feel close enough to the orchestral vocals, familiar standards, and relaxed classical music I am looking for today.",
    "Enjoying Stages does not mean I want a full cast recording such as Hamilton; today I want gentler listening.",
    "The greatest-hits titles do not give me enough connection to familiar performers or songs to make me choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in vocal albums seems to have been treated too broadly; the mood and style of the singing matter to me.",
    "My interest in theatrical songs seems to have been stretched into an interest in any musical cast recording."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent classical listening makes calm, relaxing music especially relevant to what I want now.",
    "Christmas music fits a seasonal interest, rather than something I necessarily want throughout the year.",
    "Similar choices compete with each other: Duets interests me, but I would choose Partners first rather than take both today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in melodic vocals, but missed how much my current choices depend on gentle mood, orchestral sound, and timing."
}
